title: Introduction to the Seerah and the Roots of Meccan Society
overview: This lecture introduces the spiritual benefits of studying the life of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, emphasizing its role in increasing faith and understanding the Quran. It traces the history of Makkah from its establishment by Prophet Ibrahim and Hajar to its eventual decline into idolatry during the Jahiliyyah period.
chapters: The Importance and Benefits of Studying the Seerah
Seerah as a Key to Understanding the Quran
The Origins of Makkah and the Miracle of Zamzam
The Settlement of Jurhum and the Rebuilding of the Ka'bah
The Call to Hajj and the Spread of Monotheism
The Corruption of Tawhid and the Rise of Shirk
